summary: Fix four independent regressions: truncateField returns multi-byte text that is longer than its byte budget, repeat-coalescer summaries keep more sampled repeats than their 256 cap, releasing a session-fair admission permit twice admits extra queued work, and skill ids that only begin with the letters "learned" (such as learned-notes) are refused as reserved.

patterns: Each module states its contract in its doc comments. Restore the documented behavior.
constraints: Change only src/infra/truncate-field.ts, src/infra/repeat-coalescer.ts, src/infra/session-fair-admission.ts, and src/infra/skill-id.ts.
Keep each public export and its signature.
Do not change tests or dependencies.

milestones.goal: truncateField never returns more bytes than its budget.

tasks.description: Make multi-byte values that exceed the byte budget truncate at a character boundary.
test_scenarios: keeps multi-byte text within the byte budget
passes values that fit the budget through unchanged

milestones.qualitative_verification: Byte budgets hold for every encoding width.

milestones.goal: Repeat summaries keep at most the documented sample of repeats.

tasks.description: Keep the sample of repeats within its cap while the count stays exact.
test_scenarios: keeps at most 256 sampled repeats in arrival order
keeps every repeat when the sample is not full

milestones.qualitative_verification: The sample cap and the exact count both hold.

milestones.goal: Each admission permit frees capacity once.

tasks.description: Make a repeated release call do nothing, for acquired and taken permits.
test_scenarios: a repeated release frees its permit only once
a taken permit released twice creates no capacity
each single release admits the next session in turn

milestones.qualitative_verification: Capacity never grows from overlapping cleanup paths.

milestones.goal: Only the learned root and its dotted namespace are reserved.

tasks.description: Accept ids that only begin with the letters of the learned root, and keep the learned namespace reserved.
test_scenarios: accepts ids that only begin with the letters of the learned root
still reserves the learned root and its namespace

milestones.qualitative_verification: The reservation matches the documented learned-skill namespace.

success_criteria: truncateField output never exceeds its byte budget.
Repeat summaries sample at most 256 repeats and count every repeat.
A repeated permit release creates no admission capacity.
Only learned and learned.* ids are reserved by the learned root.
